about.what: The cars this company's customers drive, per configuration, so that a generator can draw a customer's car.
how_to_draw: draw a model by share (shares sum to 1 over the listed models and include the vehicles of company accounts)
draw an age from age_weights (uniform inside a band), keeping only ages whose model year, reference_year minus age, lies between year_from and year_to; so no car is older than its model
draw an engine among those whose own years contain the model year (an engine without years is offered for the whole run)
timing: belt | chain | no_belt (chain or gears, not told apart) | none (electric). The timing-belt job applies only to belt engines.
the named vehicles of the six company accounts and of the story customers are fixed in accounts.json and named_customers.json and are not drawn

car.en: Passenger cars and compact crossovers, mostly four-cylinder (Camry, Civic, RAV4, Equinox)
car.ru: Легковые автомобили классов B, C, D и универсалы (Granta, Solaris, Logan, Camry)

suv.ru: Кроссоверы и внедорожники с несущим кузовом (Duster, Creta, RAV4, Niva, Jolion)

truck.ru: Рамные внедорожники и пикапы (УАЗ Patriot, Land Cruiser Prado, Pajero, Hover)

van.ru: Лёгкий коммерческий транспорт (ГАЗель, Соболь, Largus фургон, Ducato, Transit)

basis: measured (us-shop.md): average age 12.8 years (S&P Global Mobility 2025); about 80 % of vehicles are model year 2007 or newer (Experian Q2 2026); domestic makes about 42 %; F-150, Silverado 1500 and Camry are the three largest models in operation (search snippet).

beyond the research (class X, from general knowledge of the US parc, not re-read): the shares of every other model, the engines and their belt or chain, the model-year ranges. Tennessee colour: Nissan (Smyrna) and Volkswagen (Chattanooga) a little above their national share.
age_weights are tuned so that a drawn car averages the measured 12.8 years after the model-year limits apply; the check prints the result.

wmi: the world manufacturer identifier a background car's VIN starts with, per model. Every code was read on Wikibooks, Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI), revision of 2026-11-04, read 2026-11-14: it names the maker and, where the page says so, the body type or the plant. It is the maker's code for that kind of vehicle, not always the plant that built the model. A model with no wmi (a van whose code was not read) takes the code of a seed-file VIN of its make, or no VIN.

names: where a model's label groups several models or generations, the model names a shop record carries, each with the years it applies to (and its make where it differs); a background car takes one of those valid for its year. Written by the seed's author from the label.

measured (ru-shop.md): 69 % of passenger cars older than ten years, 9.9 % eight to ten, 13.2 % four to seven, 7.9 % up to three (Автостат, 2026-01-01); average age over 15 years; make shares in the parc (Lada 25.7 %, Toyota 9.5 %); makes seen at independent shops (Fit Service 2026: Toyota 13.2 % of foreign-brand visits, Kia 9.5, Hyundai 9.5, Nissan 9.0, VW 6.8, Renault 5.8, Ford 4.9, Mitsubishi 4.6, Honda 4.6; Chinese and Russian brands not counted there); Chinese cars are almost all 2021 and newer.

age_weights are tuned so that 69 % of drawn cars are older than ten years after the model-year limits apply (a car cannot be older than its model, so the bands differ from Автостат's). The mean comes out near 13.6 years, between the 12.7 measured at independent services and the parc's 15.5: a reported gap against the design's 'over fifteen', see ledger_rows_proposed in mix.json.

beyond the research (class X): Lada is set at its share of the parc (about 26 %), Chinese makes at about 7 %; older generations of long-running models are listed (Focus I, Octavia Tour, Astra G, Camry XV20) because most cars older than ten years date from the late 1990s and the 2000s; model shares inside a make, engines and belt or chain, model-year ranges are from general knowledge, not re-read.
